items.reasoning: Organizational change enabled by cloud that alters how value is delivered is exactly digital transformation; the others name technologies, not the change.
Agentic AI is defined by autonomous multi-step pursuit of a goal, not by model size, novelty of output, or hardware.
Only open source guarantees the right to inspect and modify the code; open standards and APIs constrain interfaces, not source access.
The pain is peak-driven capacity failure, which scalability addresses directly; cost and agility are secondary and D restates the on-prem overprovisioning it is escaping.
Global footprint buys proximity to users plus survival of localized failure; the other three are capacity, backup, and pricing claims.
Stronger managed security baseline and insight from existing data are the non-cost, non-capacity benefits; B and D are capacity/cost, E misstates shared responsibility.
A competitor materially outperforming on turnaround is a genuine competitive driver; hype, availability, and leftover budget are not.
Technology works but people did not change behaviour: the classic skills-and-culture adoption hurdle.
Standing still against faster-moving competitors accrues compounding disadvantage; the delay-is-neutral framing is the error being tested.
Making existing records usable for AI without rebuilding the estate is the AI-ready data platform claim, not models or hardware.
Own facilities plus public cloud managed as one estate is the definition of hybrid cloud; multicloud means two public providers.
DNS resolves a human-readable name to an IP address; A inverts the definitions.
Per-click sluggishness with fast bulk transfers is a round-trip-time symptom, i.e. latency, not bandwidth.
Regions contain zones and edge locations cache near users; A inverts the hierarchy, B invents a tier, D denies zone independence.
Provider runs OS and runtime, customer owns app and data: that is PaaS.
Acting during the disruption rather than after it is real-time insight; B is just a faster batch and A/D are different value classes.
Mixed structured, semi-structured and unstructured data retained in native form is the data lake archetype.
Bought from an aggregator with no relationship to the subjects is third-party data; 'brokered data' is not a real class.
Normalizing, deduplicating and rejecting bad rows before storage is the processing stage of the data supply chain.
Ownership, access rights and quality rules are undefined; a tool cannot fix a governance vacuum.
Openness and interoperability target vendor lock-in and data silos; A is an availability concern and D invents a term.
Globally consistent relational transactions without sharding is Spanner's defining claim.
Fixed fields with enforced links are relational, media are objects, and per-category flexible attributes are non-relational.
Retained for years, read once or twice a decade: Archive is the class priced for that access pattern.
Unknown and shifting access patterns are exactly Autoclass's case; manual review does not scale.
No developers and a vendor that forbids engine change forces lift-and-shift onto a managed service running the same engine.
Self-service on governed figures is Looker's data-democratization claim; a warehouse alone does not put analysis in managers' hands.
Direct connection buys live dashboards and embedded analysis in the workflow, answering both the staleness and the context-switch complaint.
A fall alert must be acted on in seconds; the other three tolerate a batch window.
Decoupled ingest with fan-out to many subscribers is Pub/Sub; Dataflow processes, it does not decouple publishers from consumers.
Both are AI: prediction from historical records is ML, drafting notices is generative AI.
Generative AI produces new content; a dashboard analyses existing records.
End-to-end resolution of a customer case with no human touch is the customer-support transformation.
No data scientists and a near deadline points to pre-built agents and applications, not building or infrastructure.
Unmaintainable rule sprawl and per-item forecasting at scale are ML-shaped; a one-off vendor choice, a retention policy and a deterministic email are not.
One real-world entity recorded four times is a uniqueness failure; B is a distractor that misdefines uniqueness.
Unexplainable adverse decisions cannot be defended to suppliers or regulators; accuracy does not substitute for explainability.
Fabricated reviews under invented human identities is deception, which responsible-AI rules forbid outright.
Proprietary data as the moat with expertise available and no deadline makes differentiation the dominant factor.
One place to build, deploy and govern agents is the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; 'Agent Registry' is invented.
Spoken audio to searchable text with no ML staff is the Speech-to-Text API.
Open-ended reading, inference and drafting called from another system is general generative work via Gemini's API.
Labeled proprietary images plus non-ML analysts is the AutoML case; Vision API cannot learn a bespoke damage grade.
AI Hypercomputer is the named integrated accelerator-plus-software infrastructure layer.
SQL-only analysts and a no-export constraint make BigQuery ML the fit.
Unknown estate and dependencies means discovery and assessment precede any move.
Unchangeable code plus a hard lease deadline forces rehost/lift-and-shift.
Keep your code, hand over everything else, scale to spiky demand: serverless.
Independent deployability of each capability is the microservices benefit being asked for.
Ample capacity but uneven request distribution is a load-balancing failure, not autoscaling.
Restartable, idempotent work suits Spot VMs; the partial-run pharmacy posting does not.
Per-host licence, specific OS build and customer-controlled host means VMs on Compute Engine.
Scalability/resilience and faster delivery are the non-cost business outcomes; A and B are cost, D is a narrow technical claim.
Keep manifests and node policy, stop patching the control plane: managed Kubernetes, i.e. GKE.
Own container, spiky traffic, zero infrastructure management: Cloud Run.
Short, event-triggered, sporadic code is the functions case.
Querying data left in another cloud from BigQuery is exactly BigQuery Omni.
An API is an agreed request/response contract between systems, not a copy or a merge.
Recurring partner demand for data is monetized by exposing and metering a public API.
Per-partner keys, rate limits, docs and analytics without engineering effort is API management, i.e. Apigee.
Stolen compute, no ransom, no data change, high power draw: cryptomining.
Malicious instructions injected into content the model reads is a data-layer trust failure (indirect prompt injection).
Cloud shifts to a shared responsibility model where customer misconfiguration becomes the dominant exposure.
Data silently altered while remaining available and undisclosed is an integrity failure.
Verify every request regardless of network origin is the zero-trust definition; the perimeter-trust assumption is what failed.
A point-in-time test is not a posture; posture is maintained continuously by security operations.
Google Cloud encrypts data at rest by default with nothing to buy or enable.
Protection while being processed in memory is data in use.
Identity was proven and logged but permitted an action it should not have: authorization failed.
Threat intelligence is proactive insight drawn from multiple source types, not faster in-estate detection.
Finding and prioritizing public buckets and over-broad roles is Security Command Center; SecOps addresses the second gap.
Model Armor guards prompts and responses; Gemini in Google Security Operations accelerates analyst triage.
IAP gives identity-gated access with no network connection; Sensitive Data Protection discovers where identity numbers spread. E is invented.
Evidence rather than assertion means transparency reports, third-party audits and the compliance resource manager.
Records must stay in-country and be beyond foreign legal reach: digital sovereignty and data residency, which encryption does not answer.
An honest comparison is total cost of ownership: capital, operational overhead and opportunity cost together, not just power and space.
Governance needs accountable owners and a standing review with named people and thresholds; visibility alone already exists.
A folder scopes the policy to one department's projects and is inherited by new ones.
Quotas cap runaway provisioning; Dynamic Workload Scheduler gets cheaper capacity for a deferrable job.
Retrospective visibility into who spent what on which service is Cloud Billing reports.
Following one request across services to find where latency accumulates is distributed tracing, i.e. Cloud Trace.
Surviving loss of an entire region requires multi-region replication with health-based routing.
Measured share is the SLI, the internal target is the SLO, the contractual credit is the SLA.
